title: Siege of Ichijōdani Castle
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Ichijōdani Castle", at revision 1375618783, opens: "The 1573 siege of Ichijōdani Castle  was undertaken by Oda Nobunaga, a powerful warlord (daimyō) of Japan's Sengoku period. It was one of several actions taken in a series of campaigns against the Asakura and Azai clans, which opposed his growing power." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q1073936, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1573 siege". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
